description:
Create, list, show and delete thread files under threads/{Projects,Processes,Topics}.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list thread files, open ones only by default; QUERY is an optional fuzzy search ranked by similarity
  show THREAD [--json] — show a single thread file
  new [--name NAME] [--kind KIND] [--category CATEGORY] [--currency ISO] [--rate RATE] — create a thread file
  delete THREAD [-y] — permanently delete a thread file

Flags:
  list: --all include paused and closed threads; --json JSON output
  show: --json JSON output
  new: --name thread name; --kind one of project, process, topic; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary; --currency 3-letter ISO code, the default currency for `hours`; --rate default hourly rate, requires --currency
  delete: -y skip the confirmation prompt

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "2500"]
  ["delete", "Projects/SGB", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts interactively for any field not supplied. Always pass --name, --kind and --category together so it never reads stdin.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given, and removes the file permanently.
  THREAD accepts a bare thread name or 'Kind/Name'.
